Select canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, and standard_units for compounds tested in assay CHEMBL4649942. Join molecule_dictionary to activities on molregno, join assays on assay_id, and join compound_structures on molregno (inner join). Filter by assay chembl_id CHEMBL4649942, standard_value is not null, and standard_relation equals '='. Keep all qualifying activity rows without deduplication. Sort by chembl_id, canonical_smiles, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, and standard_units.
